_note: 字体角色表。stack 是 CSS 字体栈（按顺序回退），file 可指向 public/fonts/ 下的本地字体（留空则用系统字体）。check_assets.py 会用 systemCandidates 里第一个存在的字体文件检查 timing.json 里的文案有没有缺字。

mono.note: English on purpose: any CJK added here would enter the subtitle font subset (fonts.json is scanned as on-screen text), so this note stays ASCII to keep the subset at 386 chars. WHY mono reuses the body subset: the mono stack (JetBrains Mono / SF Mono / Consolas) has no CJK coverage, so a separate mono subset would either drop Chinese glyphs or waste bytes; Microsoft YaHei's digits are monospaced (advance 1201/2048), so numeric columns stay aligned. See lib/fonts.ts for how the subset is registered ahead of the stack.
